query: SELECT ResourceAttributes['host.name'] AS host, ResourceAttributes['container.name'] AS container, multiIf(match(Body,'OutOfMemoryError|Terminating due|\\bFATAL\\b|panic:|state root mismatch|INVALID_PAYLOAD|Invalid execution payload|block access list.*mismatch|BAL.*mismatch'),'critical',match(Body,'(?i)TimeoutGetPayload|(?:getPayload|newPayload|forkchoice|execution engine|engine API).{0,100}(?:timed out|timeout)|(?:timed out|timeout).{0,100}(?:getPayload|newPayload|forkchoice|execution engine)'),'engine_timeout',match(Body,'(?i)Skipping.{0,100}(?:attestation|duties)|Failed to produce block|Unable to produce block|Failed to propose|Block production failed|Failed to create.*block|broadcast.*late'),'duty_loss',match(Body,'(?i)optimistic head activation|optimistic mode.*activ|execution engine.*offline|execution layer.*offline'),'optimistic_activation','none') AS category, count() AS count, min(Timestamp) AS first_seen, max(Timestamp) AS last_seen, substring(argMax(Body,Timestamp),1,2000) AS latest_body FROM external.otel_logs WHERE ResourceAttributes['network']='glamsterdam-msf-2' AND ResourceAttributes['container.name'] IN ('execution','beacon','validator') AND Timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-14 05:48:30') AND Timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-14 06:48:30') AND category!='none' GROUP BY host,container,category ORDER BY category,host,container LIMIT 200 SETTINGS max_threads=2
